# Draft:Edits (software)

[https://www.techcrunch.com/2025/01/19/meta-announces-a-new-video-editing-app-called-edits-amidst-tiktok-and-capcut-ban Edits], also known as Instagram Edits,is a video creation app that helps users make and share videos on their phones. It has a variety of editing tools, creative resources and insights.
,
Instagram head Adam Mosseri said on Threads that the app will launch next month on iOS, with an Android version following later. He added that the company is working with select creators to gather feedback about the app.
